svg.text: Phase 2 · step 4e · Garage and adding a vehicle (decisions #040, #052): two options
A section per group; ordered by newest activity or My order (up/down buttons). Readings, due items, and photos arrive in milestones 6–8, so cards are simple for now.
A · Cards in a grid per group; + Add vehicle opens a two-step dialog (kind, then details)
Tap a card to open the vehicle. Archived (retired, disposed) vehicles appear, dimmed, with Show archived.
Arrange shows ▲▼ on each card (48 px targets); the order is yours alone (#040).
Moves stay within the group: groups keep name order.
A · + Add vehicle: step 1 (kind) and step 2 (details), in a dialog
Starts with an Odometer (km, your preference) and the truck's
custom fields; change them later on its Setup tab.
+ Cards look like the sketches for later (photo,
readings, due items fill in over time).
+ The kind first: the details form then shows
− Cards take more room than a list.
B · A compact list per group; + Add vehicle is a full page (kind and details together)
Hangar and other groups follow below; Arrange shows ▲▼ at each row's end.
Add vehicle (B): a page with the kinds as a row of
chips at the top and the details below them.
+ Fits many vehicles on one screen.
+ One page to add: fewer steps.
− Less room for photos and readings later;
the cards would come anyway with them.
